tasks.title: BUG: Email/password register fails — FK violation memberships->users
tasks.verification_notes: PASS. Commit 4cc9dec: _create_tenant_for_account() now inserts into users table (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) before creating membership, fixing FK violation. Test confirmed: POST /api/auth/register returns 200 with JWT and user object. database.py uses lazy pool init (min_size=0). 2 files, 8 lines — clean diff.
tasks.description: Pipeline Tester found: POST /api/auth/register fails with 'ForeignKeyViolationError: insert or update on table memberships violates FK constraint memberships_user_id_fkey — Key (user_id)=(...) is not present in table users'. Root cause: _create_tenant_for_account() creates membership with user_id from accounts table (new UUID), but memberships.user_id FK references public.users (which is empty). New email/password auth creates users in accounts table but memberships expects IDs from users table. Fix: either (1) also insert into users table during register, OR (2) update FK to reference accounts.id instead of users.id.
